message.reasoning: We need answer propositional logic conclusion from premises: 1. Q, 2. ¬¬P. Need infer correct conclusion. We need likely P ∧ Q? Let's analyze. Premises: Q true, double negation P implies P (classical). So can conclude P and Q. Maybe conjunction P ∧ Q. Could also conclude P ∨ Q, P, Q. But "What can we conclude" likely strongest: P ∧ Q. Need format only logic statement between tags. Use ∧. So <answer>P ∧ Q</answer>. Need ensure no extra? The final can include brief? User asks return conclusion logic statement as final answer, put between tags. We can just output tags. Need maybe consider if double negation elimination is allowed? In propositional logic usually yes. Given ¬¬P, infer P. And Q. So P ∧ Q. Could also be Q ∧ P. We choose P ∧ Q.
